messages:
sarah_support: FYI urgent from Maya -> customer wants proof deletion across all storage + KMS/HSM audit logs. They say they received data after 24h. Need timeline & steps to reproduce. Can @dmitri_sre or @lina_privacy triage? :warning:

maya_customer: Hi team — we're legally required to confirm deletion. We did the account erase at 2026-03-10T14:23:11Z via API. We still found residual vectors in our dedicated bucket at 2026-03-11T10:05Z. Need confirmation of propagation and subprocessor chain.

dmitri_sre: Thanks. Can you paste the erase request id? also which deployment (hosted/dedicated/private)?

maya_customer: erase_request_id: abc123-erase-20260310
deployment: dedicated eu-west-1, tenant_id: t-78654

lina_privacy: We'll need KMS CMK id and the HSM wrap id if available. Also need the retention tag on the dataset — was it marked 'customer_data' or 'logs'? If it was logs, retention might differ.

sarah_support: Provided CMK id in DM: cmk-0f9a3e and customer says objects had header x-data-tag: customer_data

dmitri_sre: Ok steps I will run: 1) check storage object's delete tombstone time 2) confirm KMS decrypt attempts after deletion 3) HSM key rotation audit 4) confirm KV cache purge on serving nodes. Running now.

audit-bot: scheduled run: kms-audit cmk-0f9a3e for tenant t-78654 at 2115007945

dmitri_sre: quick findings: storage shows DELETE event 2026-03-10T14:23:20Z for object vecs/abc123, but replication to edge-proxy completed 2026-03-11T09:58Z. That gap explains observed object presence. Need to confirm whether replicated copies were re-encrypted or left wrapped with same CMK.

raj_security: If replication used subprocessor EdgeStorageCo in eu-west-1, they do server-side copy; their copy time can lag. We need subprocessor disclosure for EdgeStorageCo and CloudKeyOps (KMS HSM provider).

lina_privacy: Customer needs a single artifact: timeline + audit log of KMS decrypt/encrypt + HSM access log + list of subprocessor endpoints that held copies. I can assemble with SRE and Security.

dmitri_sre: Repro steps for us to validate and create artifact:
```
# run on internal debug node
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/v1/admin/exports/delete-proof \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"tenant_id":"t-78654","object_prefix":"vecs/abc123","cmk":"cmk-0f9a3e"}'
# then check logs:
jq '.events[] | select(.event=="storage.delete")' /var/log/object-audit.log | tail -n 20
kmsctl audit --key cmk-0f9a3e --since 2026-03-10T00:00:00Z > /tmp/kms-events.json
hsm-audit export --key cmk-0f9a3e --tenant t-78654 > /tmp/hsm.csv
```

dmitri_sre: I ran those, attaching snippets: storage delete event shows replication_status: \"async_pending\" at deletion time, replication_completed at 2026-03-11T09:58:02Z. kms-events.json shows no decrypts after deletion; hsm.csv shows no operator access in that window. I'll package.

lina_privacy: Good. Note to include the subprocessor chain: we used EdgeStorageCo for cross-region replication and CloudKeyOps as HSM provider for that CMK. We need to confirm their data retention windows — ask legal to send DPAs.

sarah_support: I've escalated to legal for subprocessor confirmation. @maya_customer we'll provide export + signed statement within 48 hours. Can you confirm if the customer is satisfied with a signed auditor statement or needs raw logs?

maya_customer: Auditor statement is fine but they may ask raw audit extracts. Prefer both if possible.

raj_security: I'll reach out to CloudKeyOps for a signed attestation of no key usage post-delete. Also request EdgeStorageCo replication timestamps per object id. Will include subprocessor IDs for the DPA.

dmitri_sre: Final artifact plan: 1) timeline.txt 2) object-event-log.json 3) kms-events.json 4) hsm-export.csv 5) subprocessor-declaration.pdf. I'll bundle and sign.

sarah_support: Thanks all. I'll update the ticket and set expectation: ETA 48h. :thumbsup:

audit-bot: export package created: /mnt/secure/exports/2115007890-erase-proof-tenant-t-78654.tar.gpg

maya_customer: Received, thx. Will confirm with legal after review.

sarah_support: closing loop, reopen if questions.
